lines.cap: Every night, while you sleep, your brain gets a good, wet wash.
lines.say: Every night, while you sleep, your brain gets a good, wet wash.

lines.cap: A clear fluid called cerebrospinal fluid, surrounds your brain.
lines.say: A clear fluid called cerebrospinal fluid, surrounds your brain.

lines.cap: In 2013, scientists found that during deep sleep, brain cells shrink a little. The gaps between them grow by about sixty percent.
lines.say: In 2013, scientists found that during deep sleep, brain cells shrink a little. The gaps between them grow by about sixty percent.

lines.cap: That lets the fluid rush through, and flush out the waste your brain made all day.
lines.say: That lets the fluid rush through, and flush out the waste your brain made all day.

lines.cap: Including a sticky protein linked to Alzheimer's disease.
lines.say: Including a sticky protein linked to Alzheimer's disease.

lines.cap: In 2019, brain scans caught it in people. Big slow waves of fluid, washing in, during deep sleep.
lines.say: In 2019, brain scans caught it in people. Big slow waves of fluid, washing in, during deep sleep.

lines.cap: Skip sleep, and the trash stays in.
lines.say: Skip sleep, and the trash stays in.

lines.cap: So go to bed. Your brain needs its wash. General information, not medical advice.
lines.say: So go to bed. Your brain needs its wash. General information, not medical advice.
